critical_code_review_comments: ScannerCandidatesCard.Band derives testid from title.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0]. Works for 'Robinhood (PONS · ...)' -> 'scanner-band-robinhood' but is fragile — a future title change (e.g. 'Robinhood Chain') would silently break tests. Recommend explicit `testid` prop.

test_rh_integration_api_v9.py::TestRHStatus::test_status_healthy is transiently flaky on first-run if config was just PUT with rh_feed_enabled=true and feed loop hasn't polled yet. Passes on retry; consider adding a short retry inside status handler or in test.

During earlier UI exploration, clicking the first <button> inside section-bot-control triggered the LIVE toggle / START BOT (not the section-expand chevron). Test scripts that rely on 'first button' will accidentally toggle bot state. Consider adding data-testid="section-bot-control-toggle" on the collapse header for stable expansion.
